items.title: Why is PUMP’s price up? Jupiter buying, 16% protocol burns & more…
items.whyYouShouldCare: PUMP's price increase is driven by Jupiter's acquisition and a significant 16% reduction in protocol supply, enhancing its market position.

items.title: Solana Just Got Faster—Is It Bullish for SOL?
